description: PAID over x402 inside this tool call ($0.002 USDC flat on Base, Polygon or Arc): latest block, native or ERC-20 balance, or a transaction's details. No key, no account. Call once without payment to get the x402 PaymentRequired, then call again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

op.description: What to read: block, balance, or tx.

token.description: Optional ERC-20 token address (balance op); omit for native.

name: rpc_read

balance.description: Balance in smallest units, when op=balance

balanceFormatted.description: Balance in whole units, when op=balance

title: On-chain reads on Base or Arc (paid, $0.002 flat)
